theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_cp_dir_integral_fderiv_span
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (φ : Euclid P → ℝ) (S : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ν K < ∞) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → (∀ v ∈ S, ∫ y, fderiv ℝ φ y v ∂ν = 0) → ∀ v ∈ Submodule.span ℝ S, ∫ y, fderiv ℝ φ y v ∂ν = 0
